profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I specialize in Full Stack & Mobile JavaScript with a focus on React.js, React Native, Node.js & TypeScript. I have a passion and dedication for creating web & mobile applications that are secure, accessible, performant and efficient in order to be inclusive of diverse users and needs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: React Native · Unit Testing · TypeScript · Swift (Programming Language) · Java · MySQL · Mobile Application Development · Serverless Framework · PHP · Datadog · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · JavaScript · Node.js · Kotlin

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · AngularJS · React Native · Unit Testing · AuthO · Material-UI · NativeBase-UI · ESLint · Redux.js · JavaScript

positions.title: Node.js Developer
positions.description:
Technologies used: JavaScript, Node.js, AngularJS, MySQL, NPM, socket.io, git, github, CSS3, HTML5, Amazon Web Services, Cloudflare, Bootstrap, Codepen, Sequel Ace
- Implemented limited and offset query for MySQL data using node.js for a future client side infinite scroll feature
- Setup cloudflare for new domain, dns name servers, and custom nameservers on namecheap
- Collaborated directly with the CTO & with the dev team in India on code implementation, github branches and documentation
- Setup workstation documentation for future onboarding developers
- Tested code on codepen, all major modern browsers, and for mobile responsiveness
- Designed & developed a new login screen using CSS3, SCSS, AngularJS, Javascript, HTML5 and codepen
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Node.js · AngularJS · MySQL · Cloudflare · Bootstrap · HTML5 · CSS

positions.title: Life Skills Case Manager
positions.description:
- Created and implemented curriculum, lesson plans, and taught 6th-8th grade life skills
- Developed Individualized Education Program (IEP) goals and
objectives
- Facilitated and scheduled IEP meetings
- Collaborated with service providers, families, and administrators
on yearly goal review and/or reform
- Generated and tracked quarterly data for progress monitoring 
- Created and coordinated schedules for students and assistants 
- Analyzed student growth and patterns for community or higher
education transition planning
- Led online zoom instruction for students and assistants

positions.title: Program Coordinator
positions.description:
- Piloted the bike mechanics job program for students with disabilities
- Biking instructor for people with various disabilities of all ages
- Active transportation teacher for people with disabilities
- Co-organized the kick-off event for the Detroit, MI based first
accessible bike share company
- Lobbied in Lansing for safer biking laws in Michigan

positions.title: Senior Rehabilitation Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with various therapists, engineers, and areas of CS Mott Children’s Hospital on assistive technology development for patients and/or the community
- Created written manuals for various pieces of assistive technology, virtual reality, and augmentative reality
- Led donation press conference at Ann Arbor District Library
- Participated in major funding event, Mott Golf Classic, showcasing assistive technology and continuing donor relations

positions.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
positions.description:
- Developed relationships with adults who have intellectual disabilities
- Facilitated friendships between college students and adults who have intellectual disabilities
- Updated social media, conducted interviews and photography
